name: comp-29
title: Number Input Chevrons
blurb: Number input with stacked chevron buttons on the right.
description: A number field with increment/decrement controls displayed as up and down chevrons stacked vertically on the right. Built with React Aria, defaults to 99 and formats as EUR currency.
use_when: Currency or precision inputs where space is limited and vertical stacking is preferred.
avoid_when: You need a wider input area or plus/minus buttons feel more intuitive to users.
a11y: Full React Aria support. Buttons are semantic slots. Live region for status announcements. Supports arrow keys.
